inputs.text: The owner of Blue Waters is absolutely correct to complain that the government collects taxes from them “without doing or investing in anything.” This is yet another case of big government reaching into the pockets of productive businesses while failing to enforce basic order or personal responsibility. The plastic bottles turning up everywhere and blocking rivers and drains are not a corporate issue. They result from individuals discarding their waste without any duty to their community or the nation. We do not need more institutional reform or taxes that punish companies and push them into progressive schemes that put profits last. What we need is a return to cultural standards where people take care of their own messes, respect authority, and stop expecting the state or corporations to clean up after a breakdown in family values and self-reliance.
